# Relax & Bodyline by Stella

> Relax & Bodyline by Stella is a one-to-one coaching and relaxation practice in Genk, Belgium. Stella offers personal "Bodyline" coaching in an infrared cabin (she does every exercise with you, guides your breathing and gives nutrition advice) and "Relax" infrared sessions. Every session lasts 40 minutes.

## Practical information

- Address: Weg naar As 315, 3600 Genk, Belgium
- Opening hours: Thursday 08:00–16:30, by appointment
- Phone / WhatsApp: +32 471 50 04 29
- Email: relax.bodyline@gmail.com
- Enterprise number (BTW): BE 0766.477.964
- Language: Dutch

## Prices (session of 40 minutes)

- Single session: €20
- 5-session card: €90
- 10-session card: €180
- 20-session card: €350
